data.name: Shidunzi Parkour
data.detailed_description:
▶︎ INTRODUCTION

They were once the silent guardians of the sidewalk. Now, they are the unstoppable champions of the street!

Welcome to Shidunzi Parkour! This is a wonderfully absurd casual game where you play as... well, a stone bollard, on a wild rampage through the city. Forget superheroes and chosen ones; here, you'll experience the peak of existence as the most common, everyday roadblock.

The core gameplay is a classic, intuitive three-lane runner, but we've packed it with two distinct ways to have fun:

【PARKOUR MODE: THE ART OF THE DODGE】 In this mode, you are a nimble parkour master. The streets are swarming with your stationary brethren. Rely on your sharp reflexes and precise timing to weave through the chaos, pushing your limits to set the ultimate high score. It’s not just about survival; it’s a graceful ballet of concrete and asphalt.

【MUSIC MODE: A CARNIVAL OF RHYTHMIC DESTRUCTION】 Switch to Music Mode, and let the mayhem begin! You become a rock-and-roll renegade, and your one and only goal is to SMASH EVERYTHING. Collide with other bollards in perfect sync with the electrifying beat. Every successful impact is a satisfying note in a symphony of destruction, creating the ultimate stress-relief experience.

▶︎ FEATURES

  • Two Core Modes, Double the Fun: Master the thrilling challenge of high-speed dodging in Parkour Mode, or unleash your destructive side and smash to the beat in Music Mode.

  • Become a Rhythm God: Full support for custom beatmaps! Craft your very own 'Bollard Symphony' and share it with players worldwide via local files or the upcoming Steam Workshop integration. Challenge the world with your unique rhythms!

  • Online & LAN Multiplayer Mayhem: Compete with friends online or on a local network! In Parkour Mode, you'll see other players' ghost silhouettes as you race against their best runs. In Music Mode, watch a live leaderboard and battle for the top score in real-time!

  • Host Your Own Game with Ease: No dedicated server required! The game client itself can act as a server. Simply share your IP address, and you can instantly start a LAN party with your friends.

  • The Ultimate Stress-Relief Tool: Become a bollard. Run wild. Forget the rules. This might just be the most absurdly satisfying and relaxing game you'll ever play.

Are you ready? Pick your mode, hit the streets, and show the world what a stone bollard can really do!

data.short_description: Ever looked at a humble street bollard and thought, "I want to be that"? Now you can! Dodge and crash your way through endless streets as a sentient stone bollard in this quirky, stress-relieving arcade game.
